description: Use the selected command's payload, not arbitrary preference or criteria fields. status/prepare/lint take {}. query/select use queryTerms. capture uses exactly one note or observation. propose uses procedure and existing observations from prepare. Read the skill reference for other commands. Never supply requestContext, root, audience, authorization, or evaluation receipts.

queryTerms.description: Required for query/select. query returns stored note bodies. Use a known note's exact title as one term, or one to eight distinctive words or phrases. Do not use source to retrieve a note.

view.description: Optional query view; use search for normal lookup.

note.description: Required for capture of a fact/preference/decision/lesson, and revise. Put the actual claim in body, with provenance in sources. Every note needs revalidation, for example {"mode":"on-change"} for a stable owner preference. Copy scope from Memory runtime, not from the topic's name. For capture omit id, revision and updatedAt; the helper assigns them. Keep existing sources when revising.

body.description: One correctable claim with its source and any known date, never credentials or transcripts.

scope.description: Use the current project from Memory runtime context; do not invent or broaden it.

loadHint.description: Default on-demand. core is allowed only for stable preferences.

revalidation.description: Required, not optional. Use {"mode":"on-change"} for a stable owner preference or {"mode":"on-use"} for a live claim.

mode.description: live claims require on-use. after-date requires reviewAfter; other modes omit it.

reviewAfter.description: UTC RFC3339 deadline for after-date only.

kind.description: Source category, such as conversation or fixture.

ref.description: Non-secret source reference, such as current-owner-turn.

observedAt.description: Known UTC RFC3339 source date. Do not invent a date; external-claim without a date requires on-use revalidation.

assurance.description: New captures may only use reported or omit this. On revise, preserve a stored source unchanged.

observation.description: Alternative to note for capture. Report an observed outcome; never supply its id, revision, time, scope, or an independent-evidence claim.

ref.description: Use the complete ref from an earlier successful helper result; never invent identifiers or digests.

sourceRef.description: For source only: the absolute workspace-file path already recorded in the note. source verifies that file's digest, not a conversation or the note body. If the note has no such file, query its stored content instead; this does not independently verify the claim.

procedure.description: For propose only, after prepare returned relevant pending observations. Copy their IDs into sourceObservationIds; do not invent feedback or keep proposing when there is none. A native playbook's runtime/model compatibility is added by the adapter.

scope.description: Copy the current Memory project scope.

compatibility.description: For retrieval-plan include helperABI=1. For a native playbook the adapter adds the current compatibility; do not invent runtime or model bindings.

payload.description: playbook uses steps, expectedEvidence, stopConditions; retrieval-plan uses stages, rankBy, maxResults. Read the skill before proposing.
